name: gitleaks

changes.reason: Declared tracked lockfiles, SVG text, documentation and configuration must not be omitted by upstream path filters.
Broad inherited match suppression is replaced by exact observed-finding dispositions; false-positive volume may increase.
Retain detector patterns and path-only rules, but require exact adopted dispositions instead of implicit per-rule allowlists.

limitations: The upstream default excludes npm and Go locks and SVG/text surfaces; inherited global and rule allowlists are removed for this explicit-input profile.
Detector regexes and entropy limits still do not cover every possible secret.
Exact false-positive or nonfunctional-fixture disposition requires independently adopted policy; no broad baseline ignore is introduced.
Actual repository/history, native push/fork and required-platform qualification remain incomplete.
